Overview.Name: S H S S Subrahmanyeswari
Overview.Goal: Increased energy, managing thyroid and arthritis, mental wellbeing, and stress reduction.

Early_Morning (optional): Option 1: Warm water (200 ml) + 2 boiled eggs
Option 2: Warm water (200 ml) + full fat curd (150 g)
Option 3: Warm water (200 ml) + full fat milk (200 ml)

Option 2: Boiled eggs (2) + rice poha (80 g) + curd (100 g)
Option 3: Rice rawa upma (80 g) with vegetables (50 g) + boiled egg (1) + curd (100 g)
Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (120 g) + chicken curry (150 g) + dal (100 g) + leafy vegetable curry (100 g) + curd (100 g)
Option 2: Plain rice (120 g) + fish curry (150 g) + dal (100 g) + vegetable curry (100 g) + curd (100 g)
Option 3: Plain rice (120 g) + egg curry (2 eggs) + dal (100 g) + spinach curry (100 g) + curd (100 g)

Option 2: Roasted makhana (30 g) + small fruit (80 g)
Option 3: Full fat curd (100 g) + small fruit (80 g)
Dinner: Option 1: Dal (150 g) + rice (100 g) + vegetable curry (100 g) + curd (100 g)

Notes_and_Tips: For thyroid and arthritis: eat meals at consistent times daily, focus on eggs, fish, and leafy vegetables.
Non-veg at lunch 4-5 times per week is good - chicken and fish help reduce inflammation.
When you lose control eating: serve one fixed portion, eat slowly, wait 15 minutes before more.
Sweet cravings: have jaggery or fruit with curd instead of processed sweets.
Stress/boredom eating: drink water first, then have curd or keep puffed rice in pre-portioned containers.
Maintain meal timing even with irregular sleep - this helps manage thyroid levels.
